text:
Rama Iyer: Quick sync — product wants per-route sampling hints to influence quota attribution. server will start accepting `x-rd-sample` as a structured string with `{route: 'inference', policy: 'console', weight: 0.1}`. this affects SDK header helpers.
Diego Morales: Can you confirm encoding? raw JSON or url-encoded?
Rama Iyer: Plan is to send it as a JSON string value (e.g. `x-rd-sample: \"{\\\"route\\\":\\\"inference\\\",\\\"weight\\\":0.1}\"`). legacy boolean `x-rd-sample: true` still accepted during migration.
Asha Verma: That is a shape and encoding change — risk for custom HTTP setups. SDKs should expose helpers to serialize and a compatibility flag.
Ben Holt: SDK proposal: add `client.setRouteSampling('inference', {weight: 0.1, source: 'console'})` and keep current `client.enableSampling()` as legacy. Emit telemetry `sdk.sampling.format` with `legacy` or `structured`.
Rama Iyer: Platform: accept both shapes for 45 days, then `WARN` for 30 days with metric `sampling.format.warn`, then error. Will include tenant-hash in warn logs.
Diego Morales: Devex/UI: add per-tenant toggle "Prefer route sampling from console" and a tiny badge in the quota dashboard when structured sampling is enabled. Also show quick copy snippets for Py/TS/Go.
Asha Verma: Minimal code examples: Python: ```py
# opt-in structured route sampling
client = RedwoodClient(...)
client.set_route_sampling('inference', weight=0.1, source='console')
```
TypeScript: ```ts
// opt-in; default unchanged
const client = new RedwoodClient()
client.setRouteSampling('inference', { weight: 0.1, source: 'console' })
```
Go: `client.SetRouteSampling(ctx, "inference", RouteSampling{Weight: 0.1, Source: "console"})`
Ben Holt: We'll avoid major semver bumps; additive APIs only. Add unit tests to ensure header serialization uses JSON-string form when opted-in.
Rama Iyer: Action items: platform will add acceptance + metrics, sdks add helpers + telemetry, devex implements console toggle + dashboard badge + migration doc. timeline: PRs this week, canary next week.
console-bot: dashboard-feature-flag toggled for org:staging-org -> true
deploy-bot: policy-service canary deploy started v3.18 -> staging. link: https://ci.redwood/d/5555 :rocket:
Diego Morales: Also add a small troubleshooting note: if you see sudden quota shifts, check `sampling.format.warn` and SDK telemetry `sdk.sampling.format`.
Asha Verma: I'll open PRs: py #601, ts #902, go #311 and add changelog entries.
Rama Iyer: Thanks all — please add brief notes in the migration doc about proxies that may double-encode headers. we'll follow up after canary. :thumbsup:
